name: Raphah
overview: Raphah was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, identified specifically as the son of Binea. His mention in Scripture is brief and primarily genealogical, with no additional notes or narrative details provided.
namesAndTitles: The name Raphah possibly means 'one healed,' while a related name, Rephaiah, means 'YHWH heals.' Neither name is indicated as being given directly by God, but both reflect themes of healing in their Hebrew roots.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Raphah as the son of Binea and infers Eleasah as his father, establishing a direct paternal lineage within the tribe of Benjamin. Beyond these relationships, no further family connections are documented.
scriptureSignificance: Raphah's significance lies in his place within the genealogical records of the tribe of Benjamin. As a descendant of Binea, he contributes to the biblical account of Israel's tribal heritage, underscoring God's providential preservation of His people through successive generations.
